sources.diagram: VISUAL ESTIMATE: user-provided annotated ILCA diagram (pasted-image-20261007-172052.png, 2026-10-07). Head and clew radial panel fans, three leech-ending batten pockets, corner reinforcement, mast/luff sleeve and clew eye with boom tie-down are arrangement references, not calibrated surveys; no logos reproduced.
sources.photo: VISUAL ESTIMATE: user-provided sailing photo (pasted-image-20261007-172302.png, 2026-10-07) informs subdued white cloth, soft seam contrast, small matte attachment hardware and a small lower-cloth viewing window. The window is actual low-alpha film in the same sail texture, not an opaque grey decal. The existing physical sail planform is unchanged.
sources.units: VISUAL ESTIMATE: panel/pocket height is a cloth grid fraction from foot to head; chords are luff-to-leech fractions. Pocket length/width, patch radii and sleeve width are fractions of maximum physical sail width. Attachment dimensions are metres. Construction UVs come from the actual rest-planform boundary, including its sloping foot and leech.
sources.modelling: VISUAL ESTIMATE: patch layer radius ratios 1/0.72/0.45, paired seam-light offset/alpha, pocket-core width 0.64 and closure radius 0.28, neutral film colour and binding contrast, matte eye/webbing finishes (roughness 0.86/0.98, eye metalness 0.12), five-by-ten-segment eye and twelve-span tie-down. These are low-poly appearance choices, not measured hardware or sail construction specifications.
sources.contrast: TUNING GUESS: alphas and seam width keep details legible but understated on both white and custom procedural designs. Construction and weave are baked into the existing per-design canvas texture, with no fetched images or extra finish draw calls. The separate clew eye and tie-down add two small mesh draws per visible pass.
